## Type of change

- [ ] Fix (typo, broken link, factual correction)
- [ ] Content improvement (clarity, examples, diagrams)
- [ ] New lab or exercise
- [ ] New module or lesson
- [ ] Repository infrastructure (CI, templates, tooling)

## Checklist

- [ ] Content follows the [module](../tree/main/shared/templates/module-template.md) / [lab](../tree/main/shared/templates/lab-template.md) template where applicable.
- [ ] It teaches the **why**, not just the **how** (no tool-first, no copy-paste without explanation).
- [ ] Markdown passes `npx markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"` locally.
- [ ] Internal links are relative and resolve.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private information are included.
- [ ] I agree to license my contribution under the repository terms (CC BY-SA 4.0 for content, MIT for code).
